title: Set CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=92 in settings env and prove it wins in a cloud session
why: Compaction too early wastes context; the cloud may override our value.
note: R40 (owner 13:21 CST Nov 11, "compaction: A", relayed by the retrospective; plan 8349e6a). After the fresh start, a lane sets CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=92 in the settings env and reads one new cloud session's autocompact_state with get_session. If our value wins, it holds everywhere; if not, the record says so. Home: decision precompact-handoff.
